# Dorian Award for Outstanding Lead Performance in an Off-Broadway Production

}}
The Dorian Award for Outstanding Lead Performance in an Off-Broadway Production is a theatrical award given annually to the best lead performance in a musical or play Off-Broadway by GALECA: The Society of LGBTQ Entertainment Critics since 2010 (the group was initially named the Gay and Lesbian Entertainment Critics Association). The category was introduced in 2023 when the awards began honoring Broadway and Off-Broadway theatre.
